description: windowlicker submodule: goevtx. Maps goevtx's native record onto the canonical winlog model (logs-dxdfir@winlog). goevtx exposes the global identity plus the Security UserID and TimeCreated, and carries the <EventData> payload as a JSON string in Payload (the <System> envelope's Task/Opcode/Keywords/Version/Execution/Correlation/Provider-GUID are not in goevtx output, so those winlog.* System fields stay empty for this lane). Payload is parsed and its EventData.Data[] {@Name,#text} pairs (or the lone object, for a single-field event) are pivoted into the named winlog.data.<Name> map; the raw Payload string is dropped afterwards. The derived field-extraction layer runs later, shared, over winlog.* — not here.

json.description: parse the double-encoded Payload JSON string into a temp tree

script.description: pivot EventData.Data[] {@Name,#text} into the named winlog.data map (handles the single-Data object case too)
script.source: def data = ctx._tmp_evt?.EventData?.Data; if (data != null) { def m = [:]; if (data instanceof List) { for (def it : data) { if (it instanceof Map && it['@Name'] != null) { m[it['@Name']] = it['#text']; } } } else if (data instanceof Map && data['@Name'] != null) { m[data['@Name']] = data['#text']; } if (!m.isEmpty()) { if (!(ctx.winlog instanceof Map)) { ctx.winlog = [:]; } ctx.winlog.data = m; } }

pipeline.description: shared derived layer: ECS projection + per-channel extractions over winlog.*
pipeline.name: logs-dxdfir-winlog
